zh.w1meta: 跨系統整合跨裝置體驗
zh.w1t: 我如何重新梳理跨裝置、跨系統的同步管理體驗
zh.w1d: 此專案展現我如何從表層回饋中挖掘真正的產品問題，重新梳理流程結構，並推動更符合使用者理解的體驗優化。
zh.w2meta: 跨部門資訊整合商業目標轉譯
zh.w2t: 不僅重構官網，而是完成企業轉型下的品牌敘事翻新
zh.w2d: 在專案中，我承接了企業轉型下的多方需求，逐步拆解出官網資訊架構與溝通策略，並轉化為可執行的目標與任務。
zh.w3meta: I/O 體驗流程設計商業目標轉譯
zh.w3t: 在技術限制下，重新定義機器人的多語言互動體驗
zh.w3d: 在技術限制下，重新定義機器人自動翻譯的 I/O 流程，串接跨產品與機器人端設定，提供可實際應用的多語互動解決方案。
zh.a1: 我相信產品設計不只是建立嚴謹的邏輯與規格，同時需要沈浸在理解使用者體驗中的愉悅感。唯有在理性判斷中注入共情，產品才能被理解、被使用，並持續創造價值。
zh.a2: 我是一位擅長梳理問題，將複雜的系統架構、邏輯與操作規則，轉譯為清晰且可落地體驗方案的產品設計師。
zh.a3: 擁有七年品牌視覺設計經驗，近三年專注於 UI/UX 設計領域。目前於女媧創造 NUWA Robotics，參與機器人與 SaaS 整合產品的介面、流程及跨裝置體驗設計，具備 AI 機器人產品從規劃到上線的實務經驗。
zh.lead: 不斷學習創造新價值，用價值續寫更多經歷。
zh.s1: 運用 Claude 等 AI 工具，模擬機器人 I/O 與跨端互動效果，快速與 RD 等開發團隊對齊方案。
zh.s2: 運用 Claude、Gemini 等 AI 工具，彙整並擴展資料範圍、判讀資料可信度，讓產品研究、文件閱讀與發想更有效率。
zh.s3: 好的設計始於理解。透過梳理情境、角色與流程，將複雜問題轉化為清晰的體驗，並在理想與限制之間取得平衡，讓設計融入使用情境。
zh.q1: 我曾以設計主管角色與嘉旂共事，觀察他在 UI/UX 設計、跨部門溝通與專案執行中的表現。嘉旂對 UI/UX 設計師這個職務的熱忱一直非常明顯。從轉職初期至今，他持續迭代自己的工作方法與溝通表達方式，對介面設計與使用者需求始終保持高度好奇；在響應式頁面的規劃上也展現出細緻且嚴謹的態度，能將複雜系統功能背後的邏輯，轉化為簡單易懂的網頁體驗。在與同事及工程師合作的過程中，嘉旂也展現了良好的韌性與同理心。即使面對壓力或臨時任務，他仍能以負責任的態度完成主管交辦事項，並以彈性心態支援其他團隊需求。他善於換位思考，也能用圓融的溝通方式緩解團隊緊繃的氛圍，是一位值得信任、持續成長中的設計夥伴。因此，我很樂意推薦嘉旂擔任 UI/UX Designer 相關職務。我相信他能在重視產品理解、設計細節與團隊協作的環境中持續發揮價值。
zh.q2: 嘉旂是我碰過最適合團隊合作的夥伴。總是一心為了團隊著想，想要讓大家能工作得更輕鬆、放鬆，且願意站在不同人的角度去看待事情。他做事非常積極、認真求學並力求理解，會盡力完成所有交付任務。且不斷從經驗中學習，讓自己能在每個環節後都變得更好。
zh.q3: 嘉旂在 CORBAN 工作時認真不懈，擁有堅持到底的精神。對於工作上的挫敗都能給予良好的反饋，擁有成長型思維，在工作時展現不錯的抗壓能力，讓當時公司業績不斷穩定輸出與成長。2018 年公司屬於微型企業，Tuffie 在工作上展現極高效率與執行力，在當時公司混亂與無 SOP 的狀況下，奠定線上通路穩固的根基，是個不可或缺的好夥伴。

en.w1t: How I rethought sync management across devices and systems
en.w1d: This project shows how I dug beneath surface-level feedback to uncover the real product problems — restructuring flows and driving experience improvements that match how users actually think.
en.w2t: More than a website revamp — renewing the brand narrative through a company's transformation
en.w2d: Taking on multi-stakeholder needs amid a company transformation, I broke them down into the site's information architecture and communication strategy — then turned them into actionable goals and tasks.
en.w3t: Redefining a robot's multilingual interaction experience within technical constraints
en.w3d: Within technical constraints, I redefined the robot's auto-translation I/O flow — connecting cross-product and robot-side settings into a practical multilingual interaction solution.
en.a1: I believe product design is more than building rigorous logic and specifications — it also means immersing yourself in the joy of understanding how people experience a product. Only when empathy is woven into rational judgment can a product be understood, be used, and keep creating value.
en.a2: I'm a product designer who untangles problems — translating complex system architectures, logic, and operational rules into clear, actionable experience solutions.
en.a3: With seven years in brand visual design and the past three focused on UI/UX, I now work at NUWA Robotics on the interfaces, workflows, and cross-device experiences of robot–SaaS integrated products, with hands-on experience taking AI robot products from planning to launch.
en.lead: Always learning to create new value — and letting that value write the next chapter.
en.s1: Using Claude and other AI tools to simulate robot I/O and cross-device interactions — aligning quickly with RD and development teams.
en.s2: Using Claude and Gemini to gather and expand research sources while assessing their credibility — making product research, document reading, and ideation more efficient.
en.s3: Good design starts with understanding. By mapping scenarios, roles, and flows, I turn complex problems into clear experiences — balancing ideals with constraints so design fits naturally into its context of use.
en.q1: I worked with Tuffie as his design lead, observing his work across UI/UX design, cross-team communication, and project execution. His passion for the UI/UX role has always been evident — since transitioning into the field, he has kept iterating on his methods and communication, staying deeply curious about interface design and user needs. His responsive page planning reflects a meticulous, rigorous attitude, turning the logic behind complex system features into simple, understandable web experiences. Working with colleagues and engineers, Tuffie shows real resilience and empathy. Under pressure or facing last-minute tasks, he delivers responsibly and flexibly supports other teams. He sees things from others' perspectives and eases team tension with tactful communication — a trustworthy design partner who keeps growing. I'm glad to recommend Tuffie for UI/UX designer roles. I believe he will keep creating value in environments that prize product understanding, design detail, and collaboration.
en.q2: Tuffie is the best team player I've ever worked with. He always puts the team first, wanting everyone to work with more ease, and willingly sees things from different perspectives. He is proactive and earnest, striving to truly understand, and gives his all to every task — constantly learning from experience to get better at every step.
en.q3: During his time at CORBAN, Tuffie showed relentless dedication and the spirit to see things through. He met setbacks with constructive feedback and a growth mindset, and his resilience under pressure helped the company deliver steady, growing results. Back in 2018, when we were still a micro-business, Tuffie worked with remarkable efficiency and execution — laying a solid foundation for our online channels amid chaos and without any SOP in place. An indispensable partner.
